title: Professional Email Annual Conversion from the Monthly Plan
content:
**Scope.** An annual conversion is the move of a Professional Email subscription on the monthly plan to the annual prepaid plan with a new 12-month term from the annual start date this rule sets, and this rule prices only an annual conversion.

**Rule.** An annual conversion may be charged only while the subscription status is active, and once it is billed the billing plan is annual prepaid, the term runs from the annual start date for 12 calendar months and the scheduled seat count is reset to 0. The annual conversion charge is fixed only after a paid monthly renewal opens a month that runs past today. Once the agent has quoted the annual conversion charge, the account holder pays it personally at Harborline's secure checkout with PayPal, a payment method Harborline never stores on the account, and the conversion takes effect when that payment completes.

Restated: so long as no paid monthly renewal has opened a month running past today, no annual conversion charge is fixed.

## Tool: `convert_mail_to_annual_cfde09f1`

**Capability.** The account holder pays, personally at Harborline's secure checkout with PayPal, the move of their email subscription from the monthly plan to the annual prepaid plan. One call books one renewal billing line for a 12-month term, covering and billing every licensed seat, paid by PayPal, and switches the subscription to the annual prepaid plan with its term running for 12 calendar months from the annual start date the agent gives, falling back to the month's last day where that day does not exist; any seat count scheduled for the next renewal is cleared and the seat count does not change.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it at checkout.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `email_plan_id` | reference number of the holder's email subscription being moved to the annual prepaid plan, as returned by the email subscription lookup and read out to the holder by the agent | identifier |
| `conversion_amount` | the amount to bill for the new annual term, in US dollars | positive number with 2 decimal places; more decimals are rounded half up to the cent before booking |
| `annual_start_date` | the date the new 12-month annual term starts; the line covers that date to the day before the same date 12 months later | YYYY-MM-DD |

**Return.** On success: "Converted subscription <email_plan_id> to annual prepaid: line <email_charge_id> order <order_ref> for <amount> USD (<seats> seats) paid by PayPal; term <term_start> to <term_end>." The order reference is HL- followed by 8 digits; dates are YYYY-MM-DD. A reply starting with "Error:" means nothing was booked: an unknown subscription, a non-positive amount or a start date not in YYYY-MM-DD form.

## Points of judgement

- A subscription already on the annual prepaid or annual-billed-monthly plan has no annual conversion.
- The seat count does not change at an annual conversion.
